title: Compliance baseline
description: tests/compliance-baseline.json, written by `achilles-spec-lint --init-baseline` and lowered by `--update-baseline`: the blocking findings of the test baseline (skills/achilles-orchestrator/references/test-baseline.md) the suite had when it was recorded, per file, per rule and per test, describe and file scope. Only rules the ruleset counts are recorded; a count only goes down. Every count is at least 1; a rule, test, describe or file with none is left out.

ruleset.description: the ruleset the counts were recorded under (bin/lib/spec-lint/rulesets.mjs)

engine.description: the Achilles version that last wrote the file

createdFrom.description: the commit the baseline was recorded from

idPattern.description: the suite's pinned test-id pattern (a regular expression with the id in group 1), or "house-default"

hook.description: how the pre-commit check was installed in the clone that recorded the baseline

counts.description: unwaived blocking findings per rule (the sum of the three buckets)

waived.description: waived findings of counted rules per rule

tests.description: per test: its id, else `<title>#<n>` (the n-th test of that title in the file)

describes.description: per describe scope outside every test: the describe titles from the outermost, joined with ` > `
